purpose: Central registry for character and cast-specific image generation models. Add new LoRA/profile entries here instead of hard-coding model names in scripts.

profiles.label: Isla v2 solo
use_when: Isla is the only visible generated character
Supporting people are only notifications, messages, receipts, calendar reminders, voice-over, or off-screen references
profiles.notes: Current intended TurboLoRA model. Replaces legacy ISLA_SP setup.

profiles.label: Isla v2 with Neil waiter placeholder
use_when: Isla and Neil the waiter are both visibly present in the generated panel
Neil is a visible in-scene person, not just a message, receipt, or off-screen reference

neil_waiter.visibility_rule: Only route to a Neil model if Neil is visibly in the image, not merely mentioned in text.
